Tuna Rice Cakes
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:39pm

Ingredients




1 cup cooked rice
1 can tuna, drained
1/2 cup grated cheese
3 tablespoons bread crumbs
1 tablespoon minced onion
1/8 teaspoon pepper
1 egg, beaten
2 tablespoons butter

Preparation

1 Stir together rice, tuna, cheese, 2 tablespoons bread crumbs, onion, pepper and egg until well blended. Shape mixture firmly into 4 patties. Coat with remaining crumbs. In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add patties and cook until browned on both sides.
